scope: Selected claim-authorizing evidence and scientifically important retained negatives. This is not a list of every development run.

entries.authorized_claim: All 26 frozen semantic and planner fault cases returned the expected status and stable reason codes; injected violations were detected with no false rejection in this matrix.
entries.boundary: The micro-latency observations are provisional because background load was not controlled.

entries.authorized_claim: The frozen TPC-H SF10 Q1 protocol produced accepted paired, pollution-safe standard-benchmark evidence.
entries.boundary: Q1 alone is not a workload-wide optimizer evaluation.

entries.authorized_claim: The frozen TPC-H SF10 Q6 protocol produced accepted paired, pollution-safe standard-benchmark evidence.
entries.boundary: Q6 alone is not a workload-wide optimizer evaluation.

entries.authorized_claim: Two legal governed physical pipelines each win in controlled scenarios while preserving results and record lineage.
entries.boundary: This development experiment motivates optimization but is not unseen-data evidence.

entries.authorized_claim: Grouped development validation admitted the execution-aware cost model for independent testing.
entries.boundary: Development cross-validation cannot by itself authorize a paper generalization claim.

entries.authorized_claim: The frozen model achieved 100% 3%-Oracle-set hit, 0.088% mean regret, and 2.120% maximum regret on the independent controlled holdout.
entries.boundary: This is controlled synthetic holdout evidence, not real-distribution transfer.

entries.authorized_claim: The permissive real-data fragment was correctly measured but provided no adaptive advantage over fixed join-first.
entries.boundary: This result must remain visible as negative evidence.

entries.authorized_claim: The first policy holdout failed because an exact support boundary caused 22 false conservative fallbacks.
entries.boundary: The failure is not reclassified after the support-check correction.

entries.authorized_claim: Across unseen BTS and NYC months, policy changes the legal plan space; under no-raw-join the frozen optimizer used both legal plans, hit the 3%-Oracle set in every decision, and reduced mean regret by 95.77% versus the strongest legal fixed baseline.
entries.boundary: The claim is limited to the frozen policy, candidate fragment, DuckDB backend, scale, and workload profiles.

entries.authorized_claim: The four-layer 100K BTS/NYC runner preserved result and source-lineage semantics, verified all certificates within the current PARTIAL boundary, and recorded zero DuckDB spill.
entries.boundary: This three-block source-lineage pilot admits 500K integrity testing but is not publication latency evidence.

entries.authorized_claim: The four-layer runner preserved result, source-lineage, and certificate integrity at 500K rows on BTS and NYC with zero DuckDB spill.
entries.boundary: This three-block scale pilot admits a separately frozen 30-block formal stage but is not itself latency evidence.

entries.authorized_claim: Across BTS and NYC at 100K and 500K rows, complete TrustAero execution preserved results and source-lineage evidence with zero spill; median control-path overhead ranged from 3.56% to 14.63%.
entries.boundary: This combines three units from the original formal run with the preregistered corrected BTS-100K confirmation; it covers source-snapshot lineage and PARTIAL certificates, not record lineage.

entries.authorized_claim: On full-month BTS (547271 rows) and NYC TLC (2964624 rows), complete TrustAero execution preserved results and source-lineage evidence, used no spill, and was statistically indistinguishable from equivalent direct SQL under paired 95% intervals.
entries.boundary: The evidence covers January 2024 source-snapshot lineage and PARTIAL certificates on DuckDB; it does not establish record-lineage overhead.

entries.authorized_claim: At 100K and 500K rows, compact record-level lineage was generated and independently verified with approximately 64 bytes per edge; median end-to-end latency was 3.85x and 5.18x the equivalent direct query.
entries.boundary: Single source and one unique, non-null, unmasked STRING key only; the high overhead must be reported, and Join/Aggregate/composite-key record lineage is not covered.

entries.authorized_claim: Ordinal-bound output identities reduced record-lineage storage to approximately 32 bytes per edge and reduced end-to-end latency by 49.5% at 100K and 62.8% at 500K relative to the immutable V3 baseline.
entries.boundary: Single-source identity-preserving fragment only; V4 still incurred 111.7% and 93.5% median overhead relative to direct querying.

entries.authorized_claim: TrustAero completed one deterministic governed spatial-temporal query over four audited public sources, inserted the required Mask and source lineage, exposed no raw controlled sensitive values, and rejected every frozen certificate fault.
entries.boundary: This is end-to-end semantic evidence rather than performance evidence; the PARTIAL certificate does not attest internal DuckDB operator outputs, and governance labels are controlled experimental attributes.

entries.authorized_claim: The bounded trusted IR exactly represents Q1, Q3, Q6, and Q10. For the new Q3/Q10 adapters, every legal candidate matched the official ordered result and retained a distinct observed DuckDB physical plan.
entries.boundary: This is exact semantic support for 4 of 22 official queries, not latency, optimizer accuracy, or support for the remaining queries.

entries.authorized_claim: At TPC-H SF10, Q3 and Q10 each retained three exact, distinct and stable physical candidates, but neither query produced a confidence-authorized singleton winner under the frozen 3% materiality rule.
entries.boundary: This is negative boundary evidence. It permanently stops the post-SF1 Q3/Q10 optimizer-expansion branch; thresholds, data and candidates must not be changed to manufacture winner labels.

entries.authorized_claim: TrustAero accepted and safely rewrote one Agent candidate, rejected a policy-inapplicable request, generated four physical candidates, pruned three governance-incompatible candidates before ranking, bound the selected legal Pp into its certificate, executed a deterministic four-source query, and rejected all six frozen faults.
entries.boundary: This is complete-loop semantic evidence rather than optimizer latency evidence. Selection is governance-determined after only one candidate remains legal; source lineage is used because ordinal record Lineage V4 does not support this multi-source spatial Join.

entries.authorized_claim: In the frozen governed Join-Aggregate admission, Join-then-Aggregate was the only confidence-authorized winner across 16 scenarios; partial aggregation never won even when it reduced governed rows to about 2% as many Join keys.
entries.boundary: This is retained negative boundary evidence. It stops cost-model and holdout work for this query family and must not be presented as a workload-wide optimizer failure.

entries.authorized_claim: Across six frozen record-lineage checkpoint scenarios, per-query capture, policy checkpoint reuse and snapshot checkpoint reuse each became the confidence-authorized winner in two scenarios while preserving identical results and record-level evidence.
entries.boundary: This is winner-diversity admission and optimizer motivation, not an automatic-selection or unseen-workload result.

entries.authorized_claim: On 18 decisions from an untouched Lineage-checkpoint holdout with unseen row count, query counts, policy combinations and seeds, the frozen analytic model achieved 100% 3%-Oracle-set hit rate and zero diagnostic regret, versus 83.3% hit and 2.126% mean regret for the frozen threshold baseline.
entries.boundary: This one-shot result covers the frozen DuckDB record-lineage checkpoint family only; it does not imply zero regret for arbitrary backends, schemas or query families.

entries.authorized_claim: Across 120 frozen responses from three Agent models, two reasoning modes and 20 governed four-source tasks, TrustAero handled every response without validator exceptions, deterministically revalidated every outcome, and allowed zero unauthorized plans across the trust boundary.
entries.boundary: This is bounded compatibility and fail-closed evidence, not general LLM-quality evidence. The one Markdown-fenced response remains a strict parse failure.
